title: Second 100 low-machine candidates: German→Rarámuri facsimile headword/boundary review
provenance_note: AI-assisted visual collation against the Steffel 1809 facsimile for the second low-confidence cohort in deterministic source order. The cohort contains extensive running prose, internal examples, Rarámuri equivalents, and a page-bottom catchword. Direct collation places the evidence on printed pp. 314–326, not the OCR-derived pp. 316–326. The facsimile is authoritative; preserved OCR remains untouched. Review is not independent human/philological or linguistic validation.

notes.low_machine_behavior: The second low-machine cohort confirms that this tier is dominated by prose/internal segmentation artifacts; 59 of 100 candidate boundaries are false positives.
notes.catchword_case: RHD-S1809-00671 (`Heil`) derives from the printed p. 323 catchword. The actual `Heil` article begins on p. 324 and is not represented by this low-machine boundary.
notes.internal_duplicate_case: RHD-S1809-00577 is the second occurrence of `Gegenwart` inside the accepted RHD-S1809-00576 article, not a duplicate article start.
notes.headword_recovery_case: RHD-S1809-00739 was OCR-segmented as `Hüte`; direct facsimile collation reads the article headword `Hügel`.
